items.text: The material can be with the advantage used for printing parts that are under constant stress, for example, bearings, cogwheels, reinforcement parts etc.
The reinforcement brings tribological properties and wear resistance to the material.
It can withstand higher static pressure load than unfilled Nylon FX256.
These great properties are preserved even at low temperatures.
The printing properties, processing stability and rheology are improved thanks to the content of aramid fibres.

items.at: p. 5 property bullets

items.agent: Water or aqueous solutions at high temperature
items.text: Irreversible chemical damage to the material can only be caused by water or aqueous solutions at high temperatures. This is referred to as hydrolysis... polyamide 12 is considerably more resistant to hydrolysis than polyamide 6 and polyamide 66.
items.at: p. 3 Hydrolysis resistance

items.agent: Hot water or moist air at higher temperatures
items.text: Polycondensation products, to which polyamides also belong, have a limited resistance to hot water or moist air at higher temperatures. PA 12 has good hydrolysis resistance compared to other polyamides, but it is gradually molecularly degraded by hot water. Compounds with a high molecular mass will last longer than those with a low molecular mass. Hydrolytic degradation occurs faster in acid media than in neutral or alkaline media. Standard compounds are resistant to pure water to about 70 or 80 °C.
items.at: p. 19 Hydrolysis resistance

items.text: Exposure to short wave light of wavelengths less than 400 nm results in an accelerated decrease in the molecular mass of the polymers, causing molded parts and semi-finished products to become brittle. Light stabilizers, UV absorbers and/or radical scavengers considerably reduce weathering damage. However, the best protection is provided by suitable grades of carbon black, if blackening is possible.
items.at: p. 19 UV resistance

items.text: Most VESTAMID compounds are flammable. At mass temperatures above 350 °C flammable gases form through decomposition.
items.note: No UL 94 rating for the neat resin is stated. Verdict convention used in this table: burns / UL 94 HB = not-resistant, V-1 or V-2 = limited, V-0 = resistant.
